who.value: seller (host) running a show, or a buyer

stage.value: during or after a live show

job.value: clip a show's winning moments and share them

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: It reads as the host's live view with 'Clip' in the side rail, but nothing signals that clipping is the screen's purpose.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Clip' is one small icon among 'Share', 'Flip', 'Notes' and 'Shop'; the full-width 'No bids' bar is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Side-rail labels 'Clip', 'Share', 'Flip', 'Notes', 'Shop' say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Terms are familiar to a Live host.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked on this first screen.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Clip options sit behind the 'Clip' icon.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Host tools fit, but 'rockstar_shark5597 is winning' next to a 'No bids' bar contradicts itself.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Icons and short labels carry it.
